QuestInfo.name: Make a White Song Pyun Set!
QuestInfo.0: You can't celebrate Moon Festival without making a Song Pyun Gift Set. Now is the time to make a White Song Pyun Set. Click on the Moon Festival Event Notifier on the left side of your screen to get some White Song Pyuns to make a gift set.
QuestInfo.1: You are making a White Song Pyun gift set now. Remember! You can't get any White Song Pyuns from the monsters that are 11 or more levels below you and 21 or more levels higher than you.
QuestInfo.2: You've completed a White Song Pyun Set! You can try again after 5 minutes. You can move onto the next level and make a Mugwort Song Pyun Set once you successfully complete 3 White Song Pyun Sets.
